verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a sync to QuickBooks, NetSuite, Xero or any other ERP, and never mentions GL account, class or department mapping. The internal categories, cost centers and API reconciliation endpoints are adjacent features and developer building blocks, so they do not count as a native accounting sync. Accounting sync is a fair axis for a corporate card and spend-management product, so this is "none" rather than "na".
